hook: Swift Evolution accepts SE-0564: Split Continuations
hookText: Swift Evolution accepts SE-0564: Split Continuations

beats.say: SE-0564 adds an async withContinuation form that hands out separate resume and wait halves, so cancellation and priority-escalation handlers are active only while a task is suspended.

Proposed by Franz Busch, SE-0564 builds on SE-0528's noncopyable: the new body is and receives both a and a, closing races where cancellation or escalation handlers fire before the continuation exists.
Continuations bridge structured concurrency with custom asynchronous systems.
